text:
Lena (Product): @Mason dropping in Solaris Retail intake — they want private VPC + on-prem gateway, HSM for keys, 3-region redundancy, SLA 99.95, target launch in 8 weeks. Can we triage?

Mason (Sales): They've committed to pilot, budget approved. Primary blocker: their security team insists on FIPS 140-2 HSM and air-gapped data plane. Also ask: bring-your-own-hardware (on-prem single rack).

Priya (Support): What's the expected QPS? Need to know model sizes and concurrent sessions.

Diego (Solutions): From discovery: baseline gen workload 300 req/s, ~2k tokens avg, peak bursts to 1k req/s. They want deterministic latency <150ms p95.

Riya (Infra): 150ms p95 for 2k tokens is tight on a single rack. We should plan Dedicated multi-GPU with isolated nodes, TCP tuning, and careful batching config (likely batch size = 1 for tail latency). Also networking: private cross-connect + strict egress rules.

Owen (Security): HSM + airgap doable but requires KMS integration design + audit-log forwarder that can operate OOB. We'll need vendor FIPS certs, attestation, and a signed SOC2 addendum.

Jasmyn (Customer Success): Customer asked for a launch commitment by EOW. We should avoid promising until deps are validated.

Lena (Product): Proposed next steps:
- 1) Ask Solaris for exact QPS, peak concurrency, and sample prompt corpus (Mason)
- 2) SOW scoping call (Lena + Diego) — schedule this week
- 3) Security checklist + HSM vendor info (Owen)
- 4) On-prem infra template + preliminary perf estimate (Riya)
- 5) Decide backlog priority (propose: P1-customer-pilot)

Mason (Sales): I'll get QPS and sample prompts today. They'll sign an NDA for sharing prompts.

Priya (Support): Can we spin a private eval env in their VPC for validation? If yes we need an Eng-provision ticket.

Diego (Solutions): For rollout criteria propose:
- functional parity with hosted API (endpoints, auth, streaming)
- p95 latency <= 200ms at pilot traffic
- integrated KMS + HSM attestation
- audit logs + retention per their security reqs
- successful end-to-end runbook + customer-run load test

Riya (Infra): Dependencies: cross-connect provisioning, firewall rules, HSM hardware order & installation window, TLS certs, on-site rack install. Estimate ~3 weeks lead time for hardware + certs after order.

Lena (Product): Decision: Move this to the "customer-intake" board, tag it: [onprem, hsm, p1]. Schedule architecture sync Monday 10:00am. Eng leads please confirm availability.

Diego (Solutions): I'll attend. Riya yes. Owen tentative but will try to make it.

Owen (Security): Add a security sign-off milestone before GA and require HSM attestation docs attached to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create ticket INFRA-XXXX for provisioning once SOW signed.

Lena (Product): Thanks — Mason please update thread when you have QPS + sample prompts. :thumbsup:

Mason (Sales): Got it. I'll post by 16:00 PST.
